title: Compute Relay remote cleanup request v1alpha1
description: Attempt-scoped request to delete the remote resources a provider adapter created for one attempt. The runtime additionally rejects duplicate JSON keys, invalid UTF-8, bodies over 4096 bytes, and reasons over 512 UTF-8 bytes. Omitted and false discard_uncollected are the same request; true explicitly confirms deleting results that were never collected locally. Reason is non-secret audit metadata, not provider instructions.
